spans.s: a sub-supplement, supplement to a supplement, Hariv.; VāyuP.
उप-√ ख्या Pass. -ख्यायते, to be seen or perceived, ŚBr. iv, 1, 2, 13.
1. उपा-√ ख्या Ā. (fut. 1. sg. -ख्यास्ये) to give an account about (anything), relate, BhP. ii, 9, 45.
2. उपाख्या f. (fr. आ-ख्या with उप), a secondary name, surname, epithet, BhP. xi, 4, 7, &c.
discernible, observable by the eye (cf. अन्-उपा˚ and निर्-उपा˚.)
1. उपा-ख्यान n. account, relation, repetition of an event, BhP.
2. उपाख्यान n. (fr. आ-ख्यान with उप), a subordinate tale or story, an episode, MBh.; Hit. &c. (cf. नलोपा˚.)
